project_info.theme: Direct-flash portrait under a transparent umbrella in rain
project_info.color_palette: gray, wet black, transparent highlights, soft white and yellow bokeh

main_subject.detail: An adult woman with long flowing blonde hair, parted in the middle with slight waves, hazel-green eyes, defined eyelashes, well-groomed eyebrows, soft natural skin texture, rosy lips, and light natural makeup. She wears a fitted gray long-sleeved ribbed top.

items: looking back over her left shoulder with direct eye contact
side profile of body turned toward viewer
transparent umbrella with black metal ribs, white curved handle, and visible water droplets
hand grips the umbrella handle near the chest
dark rainy sky, illuminated rain streaks, and softly blurred city lights behind her

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: high contrast, sharp illumination on subject and rain droplets, reflections on umbrella surface, vignetted dark background

technical_specs.color_treatment: sharp face focus, wet reflections, natural skin texture, soft bokeh background

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic rainy-night direct-flash portrait of an adult woman with long flowing blonde hair, parted in the middle with slight waves. She has hazel-green eyes, defined eyelashes, well-groomed eyebrows, soft natural skin texture, rosy lips, and light natural makeup. She wears a fitted gray long-sleeved top with visible ribbed fabric texture. Pose her looking back over her left shoulder with direct eye contact and her body in a side-profile turn. Give her a transparent umbrella with black metal ribs and a white curved handle covered in water droplets; her hand grips the handle firmly near her chest. Set it outdoors at night in rain, with a dark sky, illuminated rain streaks, and out-of-focus white and soft-yellow city-light bokeh. Use direct flash, high contrast, sharp illumination on her face and raindrops, umbrella reflections, a vignetted dark background, sharp face focus, and realistic natural skin texture.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, sexual pose, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: If supplied, use an approved adult face reference and preserve its facial structure, proportions, features, and expression. Preserve blonde hair, gray ribbed top, transparent umbrella, left-shoulder glance, direct flash, rain, and night bokeh. Do not use celebrity/public-figure likeness.

assets.usage: Maintain adult face, facial structure, proportions, features, and expression.

changes: Clarified the subject as an adult while preserving the original umbrella, fitted ribbed top, shoulder-turn pose, rain, and direct-flash mood.
